{{External|rs|rsc=Rune 2-handed Sword}} {{Infobox Item |name = Rune 2h sword |image = [[File:Rune 2h sword.png]] |release = [[13 August]] [[2001]] |update = Wilderness system online |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A two handed sword. |value = 64000 |weight = 3.628 |exchange = Yes |id = 1319 }} [[File:Rune 2h sword detail.png|left|80px]] The '''rune 2h sword''' is a [[two-handed sword]] that is made of [[rune equipment|rune]]. It is stronger than the [[Adamant 2h sword]], while being weaker than the [[Dragon 2h sword]]. It can be made using the [[Smithing]] skill at level 99 using 3 [[runite bar]]s and a hammer on an anvil granting 225 Smithing [[experience]]. It requires 40 [[Attack]] to wield. The rune 2h sword is often used on [[free-to-play]] worlds in [[player-killing]] to finish players off because it has the highest strength bonus, equal to the [[hill giant club]], and the highest [[slash]] bonuses of all free-to-play equipment. The rune 2h sword can also be dropped by any monster that has access to the [[rare drop table]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = -4 |aslash = +69 |acrush = +50 |amagic = -4 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = -1 |str = +70 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 7 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = 2h Sword |image = [[File:Rune 2h sword equipped male.png|100px]] |altimage = [[File:Rune 2h sword equipped female.png|100px]] }} {{CombatStyles|2h Sword|speed=7|attackrange=1}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 99 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 225 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Runite bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Rune 2h sword }} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Smithing rune items|Smithing rune items (Player-to-player trading)}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Rune 2h sword}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 23 August 2005 |update = Blast Furnace |change = The item's equip animation was changed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 31 May 2005 |update = New Emotes And Other Tweaks |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Rune 2h sword detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune 2h sword detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune 2h sword detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Rune 2h sword (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Rune 2h sword.png|center]] |[[File:Rune 2h sword.png|center]] |- |[[File:Rune 2h sword equipped male (historical v1).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Rune 2h sword equipped male (historical v2).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Rune 2h sword equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
